learning_outcomes.text: Explain IoT architecture from devices through connectivity to the cloud
Describe sensors, microcontrollers and constrained devices
Reason about connectivity options and their trade-offs
Explain edge computing and why some AI runs on the device
Describe model optimisation for edge deployment conceptually
Identify security, privacy and reliability concerns for IoT and edge AI

integrative_case: A startup builds a fleet of battery-powered field sensors with on-device anomaly detection: design the device-to-cloud architecture, choose connectivity within a power budget, decide what AI runs at the edge, and address security, privacy and update reliability.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
